_annual_events._note: Recurring events — update dates each January

events.name: Lunenburg County Pride Week
events.notes: County-wide — all venues, no town filter. Eventbrite catches ticketed events; manual-seed the rest when the full schedule drops (~mid-June).

events.name: Lunenburg Farmers Market
events.notes: Weekly recurring seed (Thursdays 8 AM–12 PM). Remove the seed from events[] in late November and re-add it in early May. Vendor site is updated weekly and not structured for scraping.

events.name: First Fridays Art Walk
events.notes: AGAL event. 5 dates, seed all individually each year.

events.name: Lunenburg Theatre Collective summer season
events.notes: Wix site, not scrapeable. Check each spring for new season schedule. Multiple shows with individual performance dates.

events.title: Lunenburg Farmers Market
events.description: Weekly farmers market with local produce, meat, seafood, baked goods, and artisan vendors.

events.title: Capella Regalis Spring Concert
events.description: Free concert featuring Halifax Men, Boys & Girls Choirs alongside Capella Regalis South Shore Program choristers. Directed by Nick Halley and Vanessa Halley, with Paul Halley on organ and piano. Free-will offering at the door, no reservation required.

events.title: South Shore Shunpike — Open Studio Crawl
events.description: 3rd annual open studio crawl featuring painters, photographers, printmakers, folk artists, rug hookers/weavers, and more. Free wharf-to-wharf water taxi between galleries.

events.title: Spring Community Concert — Lunenburg County Community Orchestra
events.description: Conducted by Haig Beylerian. Music from Pirates of the Caribbean & The Lord of the Rings, plus Shostakovich, Haydn, Joplin & more. Doors open 6:15 PM.

events.title: Henry Purcell's Dido and Aeneas in Concert
events.description: Maritime Concert Opera presents Henry Purcell's Dido and Aeneas. Professional soloists joined by the MCO chorus and the Blue Engine String Quartet.

events.title: 50th Annual Lunenburg Craft & Food Festival
events.description: 50th annual craft and food festival featuring Nova Scotian artisans, food trucks, and live outdoor music. Adults $6, Students/Seniors $5, children 12 and under free. Admission includes weekend pass.

events.title: Lunenburg Christmas Craft Festival
events.description: Annual holiday craft festival at the Lunenburg War Memorial Arena.

events.title: First Fridays Art Walk
events.description: Monthly art walk — participating galleries, shops and studios stay open late. Self-guided tour, meet artists, enjoy local art and light refreshments. Free street parking from 5pm.
